name: Kinka
oneLiner: XNK is Kinka's gold-backed commodity token, with each token representing one troy ounce of 99.99% Japanese-brand gold bullion held with Loomis vaulting.
collateral: Each XNK represents one fine troy ounce equivalent of 99.99% Japanese-brand physical gold bullion held through Gold Management LLC and stored with Loomis International vaulting; issuer is Kinka (BVI) Ltd.
pegMechanism: XNK can be exchanged for physical gold through GM LLC/storage-company desks after AML/KYC; issuer docs describe a 321.5 XNK minimum for ten 1 kg bars, and secondary-market price tracks one fine troy ounce of gold.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Kinka's whitepaper states that each XNK represents one fine troy ounce of 99.99% Japanese-brand physical gold, with bullion held at Loomis International, custody assumed by Gold Management LLC, and physical exchange from a 321.5 XNK minimum for ten 1 kg bars. Rewritten for methodology v9.14: the prior review recorded that the archetype enum had no commodity-claim value and kept fiat-cash as the repository's placeholder commodity-token archetype, with commodityOunces carrying the operative claim measurement. The archetype now states it directly.

proofOfReserves.provider: Kinka whitepaper (no reserve artefact has ever been published: full site media library enumerated 2026-08-08 holds no vault report, custodian certificate, or attestation; the promised 'regular audits by a Japanese auditing firm' refers to the TSE-listed parent's statutory audit, unpublished; site appears dormant since late 2024)
